thread:
tyler: heads up — console alert for a big WS reconnect spike on eu-prod (~3k/min) for /v1/stream/subscribe. anyone seeing a rollout?

ops-bot: ALERT: route=/v1/stream/subscribe region=eu-prod reconnect_rate=3045/min sample=0.78

priya: saw it. spike starts ~07:02 UTC. top tenants: t123, t998. no infra deploy in the last 30m.

jin: digging into edge logs — pattern is rate limiter returning 429 then clients reconnecting immediately. looks like js-sdk v1.6.0 changed backoff semantics for non-1000 closes.

katie: console currently dedups reconnects in the aggregate view, so we only see route-level blips. we should surface per-tenant/client histograms and a backoff distribution. ops is blind.

priya: quick reproducer from proxy logs:
```text
[07:02:05] client=t123 close_code=429 reason=\"rate_limited\"
[07:02:05] client=t123 reconnect_attempt=1
[07:02:06] client=t123 reconnect_attempt=2
[07:02:06] client=t123 reconnect_attempt=3
...
```

jin: current client backoff pseudo: immediate reconnect unless close_code==1000. that makes 429/503 closed sessions hammer us. propose treating 429/503 as transient and starting exponential backoff w/ jitter. suggested params: min=500ms, max=30s, factor=1.8.

katie: agree. on telemetry side we should add tags: server_reject_reason and tenant_id to reconnect events. also show a heatmap for backoff durations over last 1h.

tyler: proposals sound good. action items: jin -> patch js-sdk backoff logic + publish canary to eu only. katie -> dashboard changes to show per-tenant reconnects + backoff hist heatmap. priya -> run tenant-scope replay and temporary throttle exception for t123 while we patch. i'll monitor.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: js-sdk/backoff-fix -> canary:eu0 (initiated by jin)

priya: also thinking about server hints — can we include a Retry-After hint in the close frame payload so clients don't guess?

jin: yeah we can include a tiny json payload on close: {\"retry_after_ms\": 1200}. js-sdk will prefer server_hint if present. i'll add it to rate-limiter.

katie: UX note: console should surface server_hint as \"recommended backoff\" in the reconnect timeline so ops don't override it and cause loops. otherwise we'll keep playing whack-a-mole.

tyler: timeline: jin targets a 30m patch -> canary. katie to open dashboard PR for next-day rollout. priya to run replay and temp exemptions now. tagging @oncall for awareness.

ops-bot: NOTE: paging threshold reached for reconnect_rate on /v1/stream/subscribe. escalation: oncall@redwood.test

priya: quick follow-up — initial canary looks promising, reconnect rate dropped ~70% for t123 after client backoff applied. leaving this thread open until dashboard + server hint merged.

jin: opened PR for js-sdk: https://git.internal/rw/js-sdk/pull/432 (backoff + server_hint parsing). will watch canary logs.

katie: opened dashboard PR: https://git.internal/rw/console/pull/889 (per-tenant reconnects + heatmap + server_hint column).

tyler: great work. keep notes here and we'll close when both PRs are in prod and the rate stays down.
